speak: Business Number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year end date. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Amount A. Total federal balance of the predecessor corporation immediately before the eligible amalgamation.
Part 1. Days in the reference period of the predecessor corporation before the eligible amalgamation.
Part 1. Total number of days in the reference period of the predecessor corporation.
Part 1. Amount B. Days in the reference period of the predecessor corporation before the eligible amalgamation divided by total number of days in the reference period of the predecessor corporation.
Amount C. 1 minus amount B.
Amount D. Eligible amalgamation. Federal. Amount A multiplied by amount C. Enter amount D on line 310 of Schedule 506.
Amount E. Total Ontario balance of the predecessor corporation immediately before the eligible amalgamation.
Part 2. Days in the reference period of the predecessor corporation before the eligible amalgamation.
Part 2. Total number of days in the reference period of the predecessor corporation.
Part 2. Amount F. Days in the reference period of the predecessor corporation before the eligible amalgamation divided by total number of days in the reference period of the predecessor corporation.
Amount G. 1 minus amount F.
Amount H. Eligible amalgamation. Ontario. Amount E multiplied by amount G. Enter amount H on line 350 of Schedule 506.
Amount I. Total federal balance of the subsidiary corporation at the completion time of the windup.
Part 3. Number of days in the subsidiary's reference period that are after the end of the subsidiary's tax year ending at the completion time.
Part 3. Total number of days in the subsidiary's reference period.

Amount J. Number of days in the subsidiary's reference period that are after the end of the subsidiary's tax year ending at the completion time divided by total number of days in the subsidiary's reference period.
Part 3. Total number of days in the parent's reference period.
Part 3. Number of days in the parent's reference period after the beginning of the parent's tax year that includes the time immediately after the completion time.

Amount K. Total number of days in the parent's reference period divided by the number of days in the parent's reference period after the beginning of the parent's tax year that includes the time immediately after the completion time.
Amount L. Eligible post 2008 windup. Federal. Amount I multiplied by amount J multiplied by amount K. Enter amount L on line 315 of Schedule 506.
Amount M. Total Ontario balance of the subsidiary corporation at the completion time of the windup.
Part 4. Number of days in the subsidiary's reference period that are after the end of the subsidiary's tax year ending at the completion time.
Part 4. Total number of days in the subsidiary's reference period.

Amount N. Number of days in the subsidiary's reference period that are after the end of the subsidiary's tax year ending at the completion time divided by the total number of days in the subsidiary's reference period.
Part 4. Total number of days in the parent's reference period.
Part 4. Number of days in the parent's reference period after the beginning of the parent's tax year that includes the time immediately after the completion time.

Amount O. Total number of days in the parent's reference period divided by the number of days in the parent's reference period after the beginning of the parent's tax year that includes the time immediately after the completion time.
Amount P. Eligible post-2008 windup. Ontario. Amount M multiplied by amount N multiplied by amount O. Enter amount P on line 355 of Schedule 506.
Part 5. Amount Q. Total federal balance of the subsidiary corporation immediately after the completion time. Enter amount Q on line 320 of Schedule 506.
Part 6. Amount R. Total Ontario balance of the subsidiary corporation immediately after the completion time. Enter amount R on line 360 of Schedule 506.
Amount S. Specified pre 2009 transfers federal. Enter amount S, if applicable, on line 325 of Schedule 506.
Amount T. Specified pre-2009 transfers Ontario. Enter amount T if applicable, on line 365 of Schedule 506.
